args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, while the docstring and `tests/test_money.py` expect banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) per FIN-212. This caused the nightly build failure.

## Change
Switch `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` when quantizing to cents.

- `round_money(Decimal("2.675")) == Decimal("2.68")` ✅
- `round_money(Decimal("2.665")) == Decimal("2.66")` (half-even) ✅

## Testing
CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986`: **passed**.
